slides.teacher_cue: Four more suffixes that create new words. -ful = full of: hope→hopeful, care→careful, use→useful. -less = without: hope→hopeless, help→helpless, care→careless. -ness = the state of: dark→darkness, kind→kindness, happy→happiness (y→i). -ment = the result of: treat→treatment, move→movement, amaze→amazement. Notice: hopeful and hopeless use the same base — the suffix changes the meaning completely.
slides.expected_response: Students add -ful, -less, -ness, and -ment to base words and explain the new meanings.
slides.correction_move: Model: hope + ful = hopeful (full of hope). hope + less = hopeless (without hope). dark + ness = darkness (the state of being dark). treat + ment = treatment (the result of treating). Students generate more examples.
slides.observation_note: Watch for y→i rule being missed in words like happiness.

slides.teacher_cue: Say the new focus, then connect suffixes to one strong word from today.
slides.expected_response: Students say suffixes clearly and connect it to a lesson word.
slides.correction_move: Model the focus once, then have students echo and use it in a known word.
slides.observation_note: Listen for whether students can carry the focus from isolation into a real word.

slides.teacher_cue: Say hopeful — full of hope. hope + ful. Reveal and blend.

slides.correction_move: Model hopeful orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for -ful suffix and long /oʊ/ in hope.

slides.teacher_cue: Say helpless — without help. help + less. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say helpless orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model helpless orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for -less suffix and two /l/ sounds.

slides.correction_move: Model darkness orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for -ness suffix and /ɑː/ in dark.

slides.observation_note: Watch for -ment suffix and long /iː/ in treat.
